asset_rules: Zero text, pseudo-text, glyphs, icons, windows, controls, characters, bars, or recognizable objects.
canvas: Fill the complete 3:2 canvas edge to edge.
No transparent pixels, margins, frames, objects, panels, silhouettes, or empty holes.
negative_constraints: No UI, screenshot, software window, game art, text, symbols, shapes, panels, borders, checkerboard, gradient, vignette, shadow, glow, blur, illustration, scenery, or subject.
objective: Generate a completely empty full-frame magenta pixel-texture background for a late-1990s Japanese PC RPG desktop. This is a new background asset, not a screenshot edit.
preservation_invariants: The entire canvas is one uninterrupted magenta field.
Keep source-scale hard pixel noise subtle and sparse.
The dominant color remains #F507F5 across at least ninety percent of the image.
quality_checks: The image contains no connected object or readable mark.
The complete frame is magenta and visually seamless.
Point reduction to 849 by 564 retains subtle pixel texture without banding.
reference_role: No reference image is provided. The measured source palette is the authority: dominant #F507F5 with sparse one-pixel variation through #C845BD, #B233B3, and rare #FA9CFA highlights.

regions.change: Render only the measured magenta pixel field with extremely subtle source-scale color noise.
regions.name: continuous desktop field

style: Minimal flat neon-magenta late-1990s PC game desktop texture.
Almost solid #F507F5, sparse single-pixel chroma noise, no lighting or depth.
